## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The JSON parser should preserve a following option when no destination is supplied; currently, a supported combination of report options fails.

## Changes
The pull request adds optional JSON destinations, a report-writing function, and tests for JSON and JUnit arguments.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following options when JSON has no path — For `["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"]`, you consume `--junit` as the JSON destination, then raise `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")`. The destination check accepts every following token, including option names. — Users cannot request default JSON output followed by an explicit JUnit destination, making combined report requests depend on argument order. — Fix: Consume the next token only when it is a path, and extend `test_json_default_and_explicit_path` with this combination.
